name: ctc-phaseout-combined-hoh
description: Head of household, one qualifying child ($2,200) plus one other dependent ($500), MAGI $250,000: the 5% phase-out reduces the COMBINED $2,700 credit by 5% of the $50,000 excess ($2,500), leaving $200 - the Credit for Other Dependents survives because Schedule 8812 line 12 floors the combined amount, not each credit separately. This fixture pinned and corrected the engine's per-credit flooring.

source.pin: Schedule 8812: line 5 'Multiply line 4 by $2,200'; line 7 'Multiply line 6 by $500'; line 8 'Add lines 5 and 7'; line 9 threshold 'All other filing statuses - $200,000'; line 11 'Multiply line 10 by 5% (0.05)'; line 12 'Subtract line 11 from line 8' (combined, floored at zero).

derivation: Wages $250,000; HoH standard deduction $23,625; taxable income $226,375.
Phase-out: excess = 250,000 - 200,000 = $50,000, already a multiple of $1,000 (line 10 unchanged); line 11 = 5% x 50,000 = $2,500; line 12 = 2,700 - 2,500 = $200 (combined floor).
Non-refundable credit = min(200, 47,764) = $200; the CTC portion is fully phased out, so no refundable ACTC (Part II-A).
